correctness.rationale: For each prime p=1 mod 4, p>=5, the Gauss-sum spectrum of the Paley adjacency has simple constant eigenspace and two size-m=(p-1)/2 eigenspaces. Every Fourier submatrix is full spark by Tao's nonzero-minor theorem, giving rank min(t,m) of any t-site evaluation on each nonconstant eigenspace; the sole constant vector cannot vanish on a nonempty T. Strictly positive local loss makes exactly site-vanishing adjacency eigenvectors undamped; the complementary finite-dimensional contraction has no real eigenvalues and decays even in the presence of Jordan blocks. Thus dim dark=2(m-t)_+, independent of absorber strengths and placement. For t<m, rank increases on adding each nontrap site so that site has nonzero dark projection; trace of the dark projector yields mean efficiency (t+1)/(p-t). Independently built rational Krylov matrices verified all 15 p=5 and 4095 p=13 sink sets and the rook-9 contrasting 4-sink placements. These finite checks do not establish the all-prime theorem; the cited Chebotarev/Tao lemma is essential.
